svg.title: Timing Beats Targeting, Targeting Beats Copy
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-signal-reply-rate-comparison; chapter number: 4; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Timing Beats Targeting, Targeting Beats Copy; subtitle: Reported reply rates by outbound approach; total range: About 1% to 57% reply rates across reported approaches; caption: Signal-triggered spearhead campaigns outran wide-net lists carrying near-identical copy.; assumptions note: Each bucket is a separate practitioner's reported result on its own offer and market; buckets are not a controlled test against each other.; note: Sources - Hlib Storchak (Iy92NakD7e4) for wide-net, spearhead and hiring-trigger results; Alex Leischow for proof-assets-first.; buckets: label: Wide-Net Static Lists; low: 2; high: 4; notes: '2, 3, 4% max' on lists of 10,000+ contacts.; label: Narrow Hiring Trigger; low: 1; high: 11; notes: About 1% on a static list to 11% after switching to 'hired head of data in last 90 days', same offer.; label: Spearhead Signal Campaigns; low: 15; high: 25; notes: Signal-triggered campaigns hitting 15-25% replies.; label: Proof-Assets-First Offer; low: 57; high: 57; notes: Leischow claims 57% replies by giving proof assets first.
